rules.title: Ingress rule open to the internet on a non-allowed port
rules.description: An ingress rule open to 0.0.0.0/0 covers a port outside the allowed list (default 80, 443).
rules.remediation: Restrict the source CIDR or remove the rule.

rules.title: Sensitive data store is exposed
rules.description: A data store holding a sensitive data class has public access enabled or encryption at rest disabled.
rules.remediation: Block public access and enable encryption at rest.

rules.title: Internet-exposed workload with an exploitable vulnerability
rules.description: An internet-exposed workload runs an image with a package affected by a vulnerability that is KEV-listed or has an EPSS score of 0.5 or higher.
rules.remediation: Patch or replace the affected package, or remove the workload's internet exposure.

rules.title: Internet-exposed workload can read a sensitive data store
rules.description: An internet-exposed workload runs with a role that can read a data store holding a sensitive data class.
rules.remediation: Remove the workload's internet exposure or narrow the role's access to the data store.

rules.title: Public storage bucket holds sensitive data
rules.description: A storage bucket with public access enabled holds a sensitive data class.
rules.remediation: Block public access on the bucket.

rules.title: Workload with a leaked secret can reach the secret's target
rules.description: A workload has an open leaked-secret finding and network egress to the system the secret grants access to.
rules.remediation: Revoke and rotate the secret, and restrict the workload's egress to the target.

rules.title: Privileged pod bound to cluster-admin
rules.description: A Kubernetes pod with a privileged container runs under a service account bound to cluster-admin. Matches once Kubernetes entities exist (Phase 7).
rules.remediation: Remove the privileged setting and replace the cluster-admin binding with a least-privilege role.

rules.title: AI agent with a write tool reads unvalidated external input
rules.description: An AI agent has a tool that can write and reads input from an external source that is not validated. Matches once AI entities exist (Phase 9).
rules.remediation: Validate the external input or remove the agent's write tool.

rules.title: AI agent with a write tool reads unvalidated external input
rules.description: An AI agent has a tool that can write and reads external input that is not validated.
rules.remediation: Validate the external input or remove the agent's write tool.

rules.title: AI endpoint is public and requires no sign-in
rules.description: A model, agent or AI service endpoint is reachable from the internet without authentication.
rules.remediation: Require authentication or remove the endpoint's public access.

rules.title: AI model uses a serialization format that can run code on load
rules.description: A model file is stored in a format such as pickle that can execute code when loaded.
rules.remediation: Convert the model to a safe format such as safetensors or ONNX.
